meta.title: Text to image with a probe on the latent
meta.about: The usual graph plus PreviewAny on the sampler's output, so you can read the latent's numbers before the VAE turns them into pixels. A latent that has filled with NaN shows the word nan.
needs: An SD 1.5 checkpoint in models/checkpoints (we used v1-5-pruned-emaonly). Any SD 1.5 file works; pick yours in the loader.

notes.1: Reads one file and hands out three things: the denoiser, the text encoder and the VAE.
notes.3: The negative prompt. It is the other half of CFG.
notes.4: An empty latent. KSampler adds the noise.

inputs.text: a weathered brass astrolabe on an oak table, warm window light, photograph
